hypothesis: At least one of three new market-internal risk-appetite ratios—SPHB/SPLV, XLI/XLU, or KRE/SPY—can improve frozen V11 by timing 50% retention of genuine V11 de-risk events better than its own matched factor-availability control, while preserving controlled drawdown and portfolio constraints.
allowed_changes: F-HIGHBETA exact SPHB/SPLV adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
F-INDUTIL exact XLI/XLU adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
F-BANKS exact KRE/SPY adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
reuse of the already-frozen V3 event-only 50% retention architecture and matched availability controls
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any lookback, stale tolerance, retention fraction, threshold, percentile, z-score, moving-average, persistence or band search
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
combining F-HIGHBETA, F-INDUTIL and F-BANKS inside this trial
replacing a failed candidate after results are viewed
adding a fourth factor inside this trial
leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
using realized candidate metrics to modify another candidate
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Compare each factor only against V11-CONTROL and its own matched availability ALWAYS-retain control, then mechanically report ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags.
pass_fail_gates: full-history Sharpe > the factor's own matched availability control Sharpe
at least 4/7 fixed folds have candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe in the same fold
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
STRONG_INCREMENTAL only if admitted plus CAGR >= V11 CAGR +1.0 percentage point and Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
follow_up_policy: No rescue search is allowed after results. Do not change the 20-observation horizon, 7-day stale rule, 50% retention fraction, 25% replay band, factor direction or event-only architecture. Any different transform, retention rule, factor combination or new factor is a separately preregistered family and all three results remain in G3 trial accounting.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_orthogonal_event_factor_v4.py -> tools/orthogonal_event_factor_v4.swiftpart + immutable tools/orthogonal_event_factor_v3_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: all seven fixed fold metrics for every path
trade count and average cash ratio
source event count, de-risk event count, factor-available events and retained events
target fingerprint, max gross and min target weight
run authorization receipt, exact execution Git commit and SHA-256 evidence manifests

F-HIGHBETA.risk_on_rule: latest usable SPHB/SPLV ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-HIGHBETA.matched_control: retain 50% on every factor-available V11 de-risk event

F-INDUTIL.risk_on_rule: latest usable XLI/XLU ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-INDUTIL.matched_control: retain 50% on every factor-available V11 de-risk event

F-BANKS.risk_on_rule: latest usable KRE/SPY ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-BANKS.matched_control: retain 50% on every factor-available V11 de-risk event

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
